title: Errors on every deploy
summary: Since the API runs on two instances with rolling deploys, every deploy still causes a burst of errors.
alert: [RECURRING] Every deploy: about a hundred requests fail with 502 at the edge

choices.label: Between the moment an instance is told to stop and the moment the proxy stops sending it requests
While a new instance starts, before it is ready
When both instances are down at the same time
While the new instance's caches are empty

questions.prompt: What does an instance do wrong when it receives SIGTERM?

choices.label: It stops accepting connections at once, while its /ready still passes and the proxy still sends it requests
It exits without finishing the requests in flight
It ignores SIGTERM and gets killed after 10 s
It closes the database pool before the server
It takes too long to exit

questions.prompt: How long must an instance keep serving after SIGTERM?

choices.label: Longer than the proxy's readiness check interval, with /ready failing meanwhile
Just until the requests in flight are done
The full 10 s of Docker's grace period
As long as its keep-alive timeout (95 s)
Not at all: the proxy should retry
